description: Reference vectors for docs/NNUE_FORMAT.md: CBNN v1 files (base64) and the exact quantized evaluation of each FEN as computed by src/nnue/reference.ts (evaluateQuantized). cpStm is side-to-move POV, cpWhite is White's POV. The *-extreme networks use the full clipped weight range (|W1|,|b1| <= 505, |W2| <= 127). Regenerate only if the spec changes.
